Morgan (People Ops): Heads-up: were updating the 'Professional Conduct & Conflicts' section in the handbook to clarify outside consulting disclosure and approval timelines. Required manager briefing (10 min) goes live next week. Please review the diff and mark your team as complete by Jun 7. Link + quick checklist: https://confluence.company/handbook/conduct-update :memo:
Morgan (People Ops): Key change excerpt:
```diff
- Employees must disclose outside work within 30 days.
+ Employees must disclose outside consulting, advisory, or paid speaking engagements within 14 days of accepting terms. Managers must approve or escalate within 7 business days and record the decision in the HR roster.
```
Ravi (Eng Mgr): For ongoing external engagements already disclosed, do managers need to re-approve under the new 14-day rule?
Elias (Legal): No re-approval for historical disclosures if they were accepted per prior policy and documented. New disclosures follow the updated timeline. If terms materially change, re-disclosure is required.
Tess (People Ops): Training schedule: Jun 1 / Jun 3 / Jun 5 at 09:30 PT. Recordings count. Completion is auto-logged in the Compliance dashboard (People Ops > Training). Managers, please ensure all direct reports have updated disclosures by Jun 7.
training-bot: Reminder: Manager briefing due by 2255551300 (Jun 7). Complete: https://training.company/briefings/conduct-update
Ravi (Eng Mgr): Got it, will run a quick sync with my leads and upload the approvals CSV. Any template?
Morgan (People Ops): Yes - use the template on the Confluence page (Manager_approvals_template.csv). If you need help bulk-uploading, book a 15-min slot with HR Ops. Thanks! :raised_hands:
